summary: Iteration 28 — Billing History + Request Reminders. Backend pytest 9/9 passed (test_iteration28.py). Frontend verified on 390x844 mobile viewport. BACKEND: (a) GET /api/payments/history requires auth (401 anon); returns seeded one-off paid tx as {id:'cs_test_...', date, description 'Builder Assist Pro (Lifetime)', amount:499.0, currency:'GBP', status:'paid', receipt:'local', url:null}; a kind='subscription' row inserted into payment_transactions does NOT leak into the response (filter {kind:{$ne:'subscription'}} enforced). No real Stripe objects created — Stripe invoice fetch path only triggers when user.stripe_customer_id is set, which the demo doesn't have. (b) GET /api/payments/receipt/{sid}?t=<demo JWT> renders printable HTML containing user name, email, '£499.00', and 'Lifetime'. A fresh-registered user's token on demo's session_id returns 404; a tx with payment_status='unpaid' returns 404. (c) Portal doc-request flow: fresh request has days_waiting=0, overdue=false, can_remind=false, reminders=0 → POST .../remind returns 400 'You can send a reminder once a request has waited 3 days...'. After backdating created_at by 4 days, GET /api/portal/projects/{pid}/doc-requests shows overdue=true, can_remind=true, days_waiting>=3; POST .../remind → 200, response.reminders=1, response.reminded_at set, response.can_remind=false; immediate second POST → 400. (d) Owner GET /api/portal-doc-requests/overdue lists ONLY open 3+day-old requests on the active project — fresh (<3d) request excluded, old fulfilled request excluded, old open request present with days_waiting>=3, overdue=true, status='open', name field populated. FRONTEND: (a) profile → profile-link-billing → opens /billing (billing-screen testID present). With no payments shows no row; with a seeded cs_test_UI_iter28 lifetime tx the row renders as billing-row-cs_test_UI_iter28 with billing-amount-cs_test_UI_iter28 reading '£499.00' and description 'Builder Assist Pro (Lifetime) · 16 Oct 2026 · Paid'. (b) Dashboard shows overdue-requests-card with testID overdue-requests-detail 'UI Lead (UI Co) asked for "Latest building control cert" 5 days ago'; tapping it navigates to /portal-access (portal-access-screen renders) and the doc-requests-panel row has doc-request-overdue-{id} 'Waiting 5 days'; after one remind the same label becomes 'Waiting 5 days · reminded 1×'. All seed data (payment_transactions, portal_doc_requests, portal_members, portal_accounts for iter28_ui_lead) was deleted; demo user ends plan=basic and email=demo@mybuilder.app. Note: Resend blocks demo@mybuilder.app as 'undeliverable_recipient' (NOT a rate-limit); the remind test temporarily swaps the owner email to delivered@resend.dev and restores it in teardown. The main agent's context note said emails may 429 under parallel load — in this run the 503 path was NOT hit; underlying failure is 422 undeliverable. No deprecated expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch used in the four feature files. No React Native red screen; test file is clean.
action_items: No functional bugs found in iteration 28 scope. OPTIONAL hardening: the carried-over defect from iter27 (profile.tsx:36 useState tier default when user?.has_subscription becomes true after mount) remains open — unrelated to this iteration but still worth fixing (useEffect to sync tier once user loads).

OPTIONAL copy nit: when demo acts as the owner on their own project and Resend blocks demo@mybuilder.app as 'undeliverable', the remind endpoint still returns 503 'Couldn't send the reminder right now' even though the DB mutation would succeed. Consider either (a) swallowing EmailError and still incrementing reminders (noisy, but matches the create_doc_request pattern which only logs email failure), or (b) returning a clearer error so leads know retry won't help. Not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/subscriptions.py:166 billing_history query uses {kind: {$ne: 'subscription'}} which correctly includes rows where `kind` is missing (one-off emergentintegrations lifetime rows historically have no `kind` field). Verified in test_history_excludes_subscription_rows.

routes/subscriptions.py:185-201 receipt_page uses `t: str = Query(...)` to accept the JWT via querystring (needed because WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync cannot set Authorization headers). The handler re-validates the token with decode_uid and matches session_id+user_id+payment_status='paid' in one query — tight auth (cross-user access returns 404). HTML output escapes name/email/tier via E() — good XSS defense.
routes/portal.py:663 _req_out can_remind logic: `days >= NUDGE_DAYS AND (no previous reminder OR last reminder < now - 24h)` is correct. The second remind inside 24h returns 400 as per spec.

routes/portal.py:716 remind_doc_request raises 503 on EmailError BEFORE incrementing reminders — this is correct (no silent failure) but note the create_doc_request handler at line 693 only logs email failures. The asymmetry is intentional (a lost invite is tolerable; a lost reminder leaves the lead thinking the owner was pinged).
routes/portal.py:722-727 overdue_doc_requests scopes to {owner_id, project_id=active_pid, status:'open', created_at<=cutoff} — correctly excludes fulfilled/declined rows and rows on other projects.

frontend/app/billing.tsx:14-15 queryKey 'billing-history' never invalidates on new payments arriving — fine for now since Pro purchase triggers a navigation reload; flag only if real-time billing updates become a requirement.
frontend/src/api.ts:43 receiptUrl appends ?t=<token> via encodeURIComponent — JWTs contain '.' which is URL-safe but the encoding is still correct.

frontend/src/components/overdue-requests-card.tsx returns null when rows.length===0 — correct; no false nudge on empty dashboards. Only shows the oldest row in detail text with a +N more suffix — tidy.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — billing-screen, billing-row/amount, overdue-requests-card, overdue-requests-detail, portal-access-screen navigation, doc-requests-panel, doc-request-overdue-{id} with 'Waiting N days · reminded N×' all verified

The remind-200 test temporarily sets demo.email to 'delivered@resend.dev' (Resend blocks demo@mybuilder.app as undeliverable_recipient) and restores it in finally.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Everything in iter28 scope works. test_iteration28.py uses the same _run(fn) motor helper pattern as iter27 for Mongo seed/cleanup. If a future test needs to exercise the remind endpoint, remember Resend blocks demo@mybuilder.app — temporarily set users.email='delivered@resend.dev' and restore in teardown (the test does this already). JWT_SECRET+'|portal' is the portal-token signing key; mint tokens with payload {sub:<email>, typ:'portal', iat:now, exp:now+7d}, HS256. The portal web UI at BACKEND_URL/portal serves PORTAL_JS which renders '.rq-remind' anchor + 'Send reminder' text and swaps to 'Reminded' after r.reminded_at is set — verified by code inspection (portal.py:808,810). Open carry-over from iter27: profile.tsx:36 default-tier bug when user.has_subscription loads after mount — unrelated to iter28.
rca_of_issue: No new bugs. Observation: when demo acts as owner and a lead reminds, the server attempts to email demo@mybuilder.app which Resend rejects (422 undeliverable_recipient, NOT 429 rate-limit as the main-agent note suggested). The remind handler re-raises as 503 before touching the DB, so a legitimate retry attempt would never increment reminders. Workaround used in tests: swap owner.email to 'delivered@resend.dev' for the duration of the remind call. In production this isn't an issue because real owner emails will deliver.
